example_input: A JobBench task on the OpenCode substrate, recursion budget k=1, mode=agg: the base harness runs the task once, two one-sided proposals edit the harness tree, one composition is rolled, and the single final is adopted by construction.
note: Every module link pins the exact commit this teardown is based on — google-research/harness2 @ 1cfe254, pinned by commit (the repository publishes no tags or releases).

modules.label: BenchmarkAdapter — the protocol every benchmark implements
JobBench's BenchSpec: channels, leak globs, install mode

steps.narrative: harness2 enumerates the benchmark through the BenchmarkAdapter protocol. The adapter owns everything benchmark-shaped: task ids, the domain each task belongs to, the prompt exactly as the agent received it (grading criteria stripped), and the base harness. The method core never sees a benchmark name.
steps.representation:
BenchSpec (JobBench, OpenCode substrate):
  adapter           = "harness2.benchmarks.jobbench:JobBenchAdapter"
  install_mode      = "agents_md_append"     # cx: "codex_config"
  proposer_channel  = "solver"
  allow_subagents   = True                   # cx: False
  leak_globs        = ("RUBRICS.json", "expected/**", "reference/**")
  proposer_deliverables = "files"            # what evidence may show
steps.title: The sweep asks the adapter for work

modules.label: run_task: bases -> modes -> blind selection -> summary
RunView — 'Never carries a score'
assert_identity: duplicates checked before counts

steps.narrative: run_task rolls the base harness k times on the task before any mode runs. Both modes share these reference executions — they are the evidence every proposal argues from, and the ledger counts them once. A rollout that dies is recorded as a dead RunView, never raised.
steps.representation:
RunView (what the method may know about one rollout):
  task, label = "base1", domain, run_dir, harness_dir
  delivered   = True
  usage       = {"solver_sessions": 1, "proposer_sessions": 0, ...}
  # no score field exists on this type — by construction
steps.title: k shared base rollouts of the unmodified harness

modules.label: the evidence-tree layout, in the module docstring
assert_no_grader_verdicts — names + contents marker scan
mission() — the short pointer text

steps.narrative: context.build writes the stage's evidence as files: the task, the full untruncated trajectories, deliverables rendered through the grader's own extractor, the current harness, and any same-domain library entries. Before anything is written for a model, two tripwires scan it: answer-key paths (the adapter's leak globs) and the grader's own verdict markers, in file names and contents.
steps.representation:
context/
  task.md               # the task as the agent received it
  rollouts/base1.md     # full trajectory, [ACTION]/[OBSERVATION] grammar
  deliverables/INDEX.md # '.txt is CANONICAL — reads each artifact
                        #  the way the grader does'
  harness/              # the tree being edited (seeded copy)
  library/              # earlier same-domain adoptions, INDEX.md first
  INDEX.md              # the map the mission points at
steps.title: Evidence becomes a file tree, guarded by tripwires

modules.label: the INV job — 'match each failure to the cheapest effective component'
the DOM job — practitioner knowledge, no invented authorities
_call_fingerprint — content-addressed, cached sessions

steps.narrative: Each proposal is a full agent session in a throwaway directory, not an API call. The INV session may only fix how the agent works (procedure, matched to the cheapest effective component); the DOM session may only add practitioner knowledge (and is told never to invent an authority or citation). Both read the same base evidence. The edited tree is harvested from the temp dir before it is destroyed; the call is cached under a SHA-256 fingerprint of mission + evidence + workspace.
steps.representation:
proposer.call(mission, workspace) -> ProposerReply
  prompt_sha256  = fingerprint(mission, evidence, mode, task)
  workspace      = tmp/<session>/  (context/ copy + harness/)
  channels: opencode --model <solver>  |  claude -p (Vertex)
  env: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY et al. stripped (_DROP_ENV)
  reply ends with <notes>…</notes>, parsed by the caller
steps.title: Two one-sided proposals: INV and DOM

modules.label: _accept_tree — repair, validate, tripwire, in that order
_check_skills — the silent-failure rules for skills
autotrigger — append the missing trigger line, cap-aware

steps.narrative: A returned tree is not trusted. _accept_tree first repairs missing skill trigger lines (autotrigger, within the always-on cap), then runs tree.validate against the substrate's surface rules — budgets, skill name/directory identity, hook events the framework actually dispatches, scripts that must compile — then the adapter's own invariants, then the grader-verdict scan. An invalid tree gets exactly one retry with the rejection text fed back; after that the stage keeps the current harness and records fell_back.
steps.representation:
validate(tree, surface) -> census, or ValueError listing every problem:
  'skills/docx/SKILL.md frontmatter name 'documents' != directory
   'docx' — a name/directory mismatch is dropped SILENTLY at load'
  'skills/x/SKILL.md is never named in always-on text —
   an untriggered skill is dead weight'
  census: {always_on_chars, skills, scripts, hooks, refs, bytes}
steps.title: Accept the edit: repair, validate, or inherit

modules.label: run_parallel — WIDTH: independent draws, independent compositions
run_sequential — DEPTH: every checkpoint is a final
diversity — pairwise line-Jaccard over final trees

steps.narrative: In parallel mode each of the k AGG stages sees the same pool — every candidate's harness, rollout, harness.diff and the INV/DOM decision notes — and composes its own final independently; the finals' pairwise line-Jaccard diversity is recorded so a collapse to one body is visible. In sequential mode the same budget becomes k checkpointed rounds, each arguing from the previous round's execution, and every checkpoint is a final. Either way the ledger's identity holds: R = 4k rollouts, P = 3k sessions.
steps.representation:
run_parallel(task, k=2) finals:
  agg1  (from pool: inv1, inv2, dom1, dom2)
  agg2  (independent composition, same pool)
  diversity(finals) = 0.41   # mean pairwise line-Jaccard distance
  ledger: rollouts 8 = 4k, sessions 6 = 3k  ✓
steps.title: Compose: k independent aggregations

modules.label: selection_pool — 'no abstention by construction'
assign_ids — canonical sort, SHA-1-seeded shuffle
trivial_selection — k=1 needs no selector session

steps.narrative: The pool is the k finals and nothing else — the base executions are passed in and deliberately unused, so the selector cannot abstain. Non-delivered candidates are dropped first (each drop recorded), survivors are anonymized by canonical sort plus a seeded shuffle, and the selector session judges deliverable text, complete and untrimmed — never a score, never a trajectory. At k=1 no session runs at all: the single final is delivered by construction.
steps.representation:
selection.json:
  pool        = ["agg1", "agg2"]        # base1 NOT in the pool
  dropped     = []                        # non-delivered, with causes
  anon        = {"A": "agg2", "B": "agg1"}   # seeded shuffle
  chosen      = "agg1"   via ```choice B```
  why         = "<why>…</why> from the selector session"
steps.title: Blind selection over exactly the finals

modules.label: Library.add — tripwire check, then tree + EXPERIENCE.md
_distil — the cue/lesson/evidence gate
judge.py — 'Nothing in the method imports this module'

steps.narrative: A reflection session reads the whole adoption — candidates, harnesses, rollouts, decision notes, the base tree for contrast — and distils per-edit verdicts plus a transferable lesson as cue / lesson / evidence / confidence. Unless all of cue, lesson and evidence are present, nothing is stored. What is stored is the adopted harness as its full tree plus EXPERIENCE.md, in the per-(run, mode, domain) library the next task in the domain will read. Scoring happens only afterwards, in the separate judge pass, which the method never imports.
steps.representation:
library/<domain>/<task>/
  harness/        # the WHOLE adopted tree — 'never a summary'
  EXPERIENCE.md
    ## Why this was chosen
    ## What each edit did        (per-edit verdicts)
    ## Transferable lesson
       Cue: …  Lesson: …  Evidence: …  Confidence: …
steps.title: Reflection writes the library entry

title: One JobBench task, end to end — Harness² (agg mode)
